title: Silver Rewards Card: Maximizing Rewards on Business Travel and Tech Expenses
summary: This document gives tactics for maximizing rewards on the Silver Rewards Card by routing air, lodging, and transportation charges and placing recurring software/SaaS on autopay for consistent category earnings. It also states that maintaining the premium subscription results in 0% foreign transaction fees on international purchases, suggests earning at least 1.0% back on non-category spend, and recommends redeeming after reaching 17 within a single statement period by timing around billing cycles. It includes admin steps to update vendor lists, confirm category alignment on posted transactions, and request a category review if misclassified.
